title: Insert into a max-heap
summary: Add the new value at the end, then swap it upwards while it is larger than its parent.

checkpoints.text: 40, 20 and 30 are in. In a max-heap every parent is at least as large as its children, so the largest value is always at the root.
50 goes into the next free cell, 3, which makes it the left child of 20. The heap rule is broken: 50 is larger than its parent.
50 and 20 swap, so 50 moves up one level.
50 is still larger than its new parent, 40, so they swap too. 50 is now the root.
50 40 30 20. The new value climbed at most one level per swap, and a complete tree of n values has about log₂ n levels, so insertion is O(log n).
